scope: One change at a time on the four production Mage requests against 2 to 5 copies of the boss (validation/2026-10-06-mage-multi-target-census/bases): at three targets every variant of tools/mage_census.py, and at two, four and five targets the variants that cast one spell from the top of the rotation, alone and with the talent that grants it, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust.
generator: for N from 2 to 5, python3 tools/mage_census.py --bases validation/2026-10-06-mage-multi-target-census/bases/N-targets --output <scratch>/mcN; the variants of mc3 and those of mc2, mc4 and mc5 whose name holds --cast- are each compared as N-targets--NAME.request.json
rerun: python3 tools/prepared_v2.py compare --output <scratch> <variants>/*.request.json, with the variants renamed as the generator says

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every request matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log.
